svg.title: Matched-face quality comparison across five image metrics
svg.desc: Direction-adjusted changes for ManyMesh versus QEM and meshoptimizer across 21 models. Positive favors ManyMesh. The four primary metrics and post-hoc LPIPS supplement all favor the controls.
svg.text: Matched-face image quality favors deterministic controls
Direction-adjusted change; positive favors ManyMesh. Primary metrics use familywise 95% intervals.
21 models; 16 source groups. Primary metric intervals are familywise 95% max-t; native units differ across panels.
LPIPS uses an individual 95% interval as a post-hoc metric on this same cohort; it is not independent or human-preference evidence.
